svg.title: Idolatry
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Isaiah 44:16-17): a carpenter kneeling before a stone idol on a plinth, a charcoal fire burning beside him. Caption: "Half the log bakes his bread. The rest becomes his god." The carpenter says: "Deliver me, for you are my god!" Panel 2 (1 Corinthians 10:20): Paul standing at the left, pointing toward a man offering at a stone idol. Caption: "The worship goes somewhere." Paul says: "What pagans sacrifice they offer to demons and not to God." Note: "Scripture names demons where a god is worshipped (Deuteronomy 32:17)." Panel 3 (Matthew 6:24): Jesus teaching on a hillside, three disciples listening. Caption: "The idol Paul names in the church is greed (Colossians 3:5)." Jesus says: "You cannot serve God and money." Panel 4 (Deuteronomy 8:17): Moses with his staff, speaking to a small crowd of Israelites. Caption: "Pride opens the door to other gods." Moses says: "Beware lest you say in your heart, ‘My power and the might of my hand have gotten me this wealth.’" Panel 5 (1 John 5:20-21): John, an old man, speaking to a gathered church. Caption: "John has just named Jesus Christ “the true God and eternal life.”" John says: "Little children, keep yourselves from idols." The point: Whatever you trust and serve in God’s place is an idol. Turn from it to the living God and His Son Jesus Christ, the true God (1 Thessalonians 1:9; 1 John 5:20-21).
